title: Mackenzie Cramblit
deck: Authority, without distance. A personal brand for a career coach.
services: Personal brand strategy / Visual identity / Brand guidelines / Social media design
intro: Mackenzie Cramblit helps management consultants think through their next career move. Her personal brand needed to hold two qualities together: the confidence of an experienced advisor and the warmth of someone who understands the uncertainty behind a big decision. This identity translates that balance into a practical visual and verbal system.
decision: The direction starts with the audience: ambitious professionals who value sound reasoning but also need reassurance. Structured layouts and a deep blue foundation bring authority; teal, warmer accents and expressive typography introduce a more approachable voice. The aim is a presence that feels credible without becoming corporate or distant.
system: The guidelines connect audience insight with everyday design decisions. Poppins provides a clear typographic foundation, with Playfair Display adding contrast for selected statements and editorial moments. Defined colour roles, image treatments, illustration guidance and icon rules keep the visual language coherent. Voice principles connect clarity and confidence with transformation, achievement and well-being.
design_copy: The following 17 guideline slides move from positioning and audience to typography, colour, tone and application. Social templates and profile treatments show how the direction can carry across a personal brand’s daily communication. Open a slide to inspect the original detail.
goals: Balance professional authority with an approachable coaching presence
Translate audience insight into visual and verbal design principles
Create reusable guidance for social content and brand communication
deliverables: Personal brand positioning and audience guidance
Poppins and Playfair Display typography guidance

intro: INTELLIGNCE began with an idea: bring human creativity and AI capability into one practice. The name and symbol were developed together to express that relationship, giving the business a recognisable identity rooted in understanding people.
decision: I explored more than 30 symbol variations before arriving at a softened interpretation of the psychology symbol, Ψ. Rounded curves make the form more approachable, balancing a reference to human understanding with a forward-looking technology business.
goals: Give Intellignce a recognisable visual identity
Connect the symbol with a versatile visual language
Maintain continuity between physical and digital touchpoints
system: The symbol anchors the visual language across stationery, digital presentation and branded objects. Its role is to keep the identity connected as the business moves between creative work and technology.

title: Fakhr-e-Qoum
deck: A century of community history. A ten-minute documentary.
services: Producing & directing / Research & scripting / Storyboarding / Editing & VFX / Sound design
intro: Fakhr-e-Qoum brings the history and work of AHKN, Anjuman e Hussania Khawajgan Narowali, into a documentary of approximately ten minutes. The production needed to connect a century of heritage with the work of 17 departments, without losing the people or purpose behind the organisation.
decision: As producer and director, I oversaw the project across research, scripting, production and post-production. Storyboarding mapped 51 scenes, helping the team balance aerial footage, dramatic sequences, departmental introductions and an interview within a compact running time.
goals: Connect a century of heritage with the work of 17 departments
Build a coherent narrative within approximately ten minutes
Present sensitive community subjects with care
system: Editing, visual effects, voice-over, sound effects and background music bring the different production elements into one narrative. The emphasis is on pace and clarity, with a consistent tone across the organisation’s history, current work and fundraising context.
deliverables: Editing, visual effects and audio treatment

seo_description: Explore behind-the-scenes visuals from Documentary Fakhr-e-Qoum 2023, presented in Hadi Hassan’s film and visual storytelling portfolio.

article_sections.title: Research before the camera
paragraphs: The process began with the organisation’s history and the work of its departments. The script distilled that material into a structure the viewer could follow, and the storyboard gave production a shared plan before filming.

article_sections.title: A production with several visual languages
paragraphs: Aerial views establish scale and place. Dramatic scenes add emotional context, while departmental introductions and an interview bring specificity to the story. These elements were planned as parts of one film rather than separate promotional segments.

article_sections.title: Respect within the frame
paragraphs: The presentation of the Khawajgan community required particular care. In sequences about zakat and sadaqat, direct faces were deliberately avoided. That choice kept dignity and cultural sensitivity central to the way the story was told.

article_sections.title: Research before a visual direction.
paragraphs: I began with the organisation’s history, structure, election rules and welfare work. Audience research helped shape communication for different generations within the community.

The campaign’s central idea reflected more than twelve years of service: continuity, expressed through a consistent and recognisable communication system. References from other campaigns informed clarity of communication; the visual language was developed for this community’s culture and Urdu language.

article_sections.title: Five pillars. A clearer story.
paragraphs: Values established the campaign’s principles. The manifesto and Vision 2030 set out its proposed direction. Achievements documented previous welfare work through publications, summaries, podcasts and short videos.

Community education explained the organisation, its welfare activities and the election process. Responses to criticism were prepared as a separate pillar, with an emphasis on factual, respectful communication.

article_sections.title: From direction to delivery.
paragraphs: Red became the distinguishing colour, supported by yellow accents, Urdu typography, structured layouts and photography. The same system connected publications, outdoor advertising, social content, video, event materials and merchandise.
Delivery involved writers, designers, photographers and volunteers. My role connected the creative direction with production so that each format felt part of one campaign.

article_sections.title: The outcome, honestly.
paragraphs: The campaign did not win the election. The result is part of the case study, alongside the research, creative work and coordinated delivery.

The experience reinforced the value of clear research, consistent execution and collaboration under pressure. A visual identity is one part of a much wider relationship between an organisation and its community.

deck: A locked door. A curious character. A world built through AI.

intro: A mysterious door, a curious child and a birthday surprise. system: The workflow combined ChatGPT-assisted scene planning, AI image and motion experiments, manual Photoshop refinement, layered sound design and a final Premiere Pro edit. The production screenshots show where generated material needed deliberate craft.

gallery_chapters.title: Start with the story.
gallery_chapters.label: 01 / Concept Development
gallery_chapters.copy: The Soul Publishing supplied the script. I used ChatGPT to break it into scenes, character descriptions, props, lighting and transitions, then developed reusable prompt structures. These early concepts explore the cast and the atmosphere before the visual direction settles.

gallery_chapters.title: Give the mystery a world.
gallery_chapters.label: 02 / World Building
gallery_chapters.copy: Image development included experiments with Midjourney, Google ImageFX, Leonardo AI, Ideogram and Helio AI. Rooms, props and light establish the setting; recurring environmental cues make separate generated images feel connected.

gallery_chapters.title: Make curiosity visible.
gallery_chapters.label: 03 / Character Direction
gallery_chapters.copy: Locked character descriptions, wardrobe details and lighting cues helped reduce visual drift. Expressions, gestures and camera distance give the characters a point of view, while repeated details support continuity across the scene variations.

gallery_chapters.title: The smallest detail has to make sense.
gallery_chapters.label: 04 / The Mystery
gallery_chapters.copy: The mechanical lock became a practical test of AI’s limits. Generated gears and letter dials did not always align or behave convincingly. Photoshop refinement brought the details closer to the intended design, keeping the object readable within the story.

gallery_chapters.title: From suspense to surprise.
gallery_chapters.label: 05 / Celebration
gallery_chapters.copy: Warm light, balloons and group compositions shift the emotional register. Reaction shots and birthday details contrast with the darker doorway scenes, giving the visual sequence a clearer change in mood.

gallery_chapters.title: Build the sequence, frame by frame.
gallery_chapters.label: 06 / Motion Development
gallery_chapters.copy: Image-to-video experiments included Runway, Pica, Sora and Helio Video AI. These supplied files preserve individual story frames; they are still images rather than playable motion clips. The focus is continuity between the source visuals and the intended sequence.

gallery_chapters.title: The craft between generation and delivery.
gallery_chapters.label: 07 / Production Process
gallery_chapters.copy: Manual image refinement continued in Photoshop. The Soul Publishing supplied narration created with ElevenLabs; I shaped the wider soundscape with Envato Elements effects, including room atmosphere, doors and party sounds. Premiere Pro brought the scenes, audio and text together. The timelines show the layered assembly behind the result.
